identity.name: iShares High Yield Corporate Bond BuyWrite Strategy ETF (Ondo Tokenized ETF)

about.description: HYGWon is an Ondo Stocks tokenized ETF exposure designed to provide economic exposure to the iShares High Yield Corporate Bond BuyWrite Strategy ETF (HYGW) in an onchain format. The underlying HYGW seeks to track the Cboe HYG BuyWrite Index, which holds the iShares iBoxx dollar High Yield Corporate Bond ETF (HYG) while writing one-month covered call options on HYG shares to generate income. The short call position is fully covered by the long HYG position at all times, so the strategy exchanges upside participation above the strike for the option premium collected. This covered-call overlay produces enhanced monthly income relative to holding HYG outright, but caps upside during rallies and continues to bear the credit and duration risk of the underlying high yield corporate bond portfolio. The token is designed to be fully backed by the underlying publicly traded asset, together with cash in transit, held with regulated custodial broker-dealers. Holdings attestations and ongoing reporting are surfaced through Ondo trust and transparency materials and the product asset page. Tokenholders are not shareholders of the underlying and do not receive shareholder voting rights. Dividend value is reflected through total return mechanics. Ondo Stocks adjusts the token to account for dividends net of withholding taxes and reinvests that value into additional shares, increasing the shares per token over time instead of paying cash dividends directly to tokenholders.
about.registryInfo: Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited issues Ondo Stocks tokens as structured notes designed to track the performance of the corresponding underlying publicly traded stock or ETF (including dividends, which are reinvested where applicable). The notes are governed by the Issuer's Sales Terms under Swiss law. GM tokens are fully backed 1:1 by the corresponding underlying securities held with regulated custodial broker-dealers, plus an additional collateral buffer. Ondo publishes ongoing attestations and reporting for GM token backing (verified by Ankura Trust Company).
